content.short: SnowPunkz is a hand-drawn interactive pixelart NFT collection of 2,000 unique SnowPunkz!
content.description:
It is an unique community driven Cardano NFT project. A NFT that rewards SnowPunk holders. Unlike most CNFT projects, the team behind SnowPunkz have built a roadmap which contains donations to environmental projects, such as projects that plant trees.

The goal of SnowPunkz is to fight global warming, as it is one of the biggest concerns the world is currently facing.

Project releases on March 14, 2022.
